origin: Own controlled noninteracting pi-electron model on the neutral cyclobutadiene molecular graph, supplied asC1=CC=C1. The model deliberately omits electron repulsion, spin-dependent interactions, nuclear kinetic energy, solvent and real bond-length calibration. The supplied elastic coefficient, hopping law and temperatures are assumptions, not measured cyclobutadiene properties. No synthetic preparation or experimental structural prediction is requested.
graph_and_pi_space: Acquire the molecular formula, the actual heavy-atom graph adjacency in input atom order and its cycle/ring/aromatic flags using the molecular graph tools. There are four carbon p orbitals and FOUR pi electrons in this stipulated neutral model, not one pi electron per explicit double-bond token. Check that the graph is the4cycle0-1-2-3-0. Molecular SMILES bond-order/aromatic flags are identity/perception information; they do not directly assign the model hopping, a many-electron state, thermodynamic stability or a magnetic aromaticity index.
one_electron_model: In fixed input atom order i=0,1,2,3, the one-electron Hamiltonian H has zero diagonal and H[i,(i+1)mod4]=H[(i+1)mod4,i]=-(1+(-1)^i*delta). All other entries0. delta is a SIGNED dimensionless bond-alternation coordinate in[-0.5,0.5]. The hopping energy unit is1; temperature T denotes k_B*T_physical in that same energy unit. Each spatial orbital has two independent spin states. Retain actual typed symmetric eigendecomposition observations at delta=0, delta=0.1, delta=0.5 and each DISTINCT positive equilibrium distortion found below. Verify spectra and degeneracies. The delta=0 zero-energy orbital degeneracy must not be discarded or assigned arbitrary unique occupations.
canonical_scientific_model: The molecule is electrically isolated: N_pi=4 is exact in every state. For fixed delta,T>0, use the canonical partition Z4=sum_over_all4occupied_spin_orbitals exp(-sum_occupied_epsilon/T), with each valid spin-orbital Slater determinant counted ONCE. Equivalently take the coefficient of z^4 in product_j(1+z*exp(-epsilon_j/T))^2. If grouping spatial occupations n_j in{0,1,2}, retain the multiplicity product_j binom(2,n_j) and sum_j n_j=4. Neither independent Fermi occupation probabilities nor equal weights on distinct occupation-count vectors implement this ensemble. Enumerate complete states or use an exact coefficient/dynamic-programming identity; retain normalization and all source-aligned weights/sufficient spectral moments. The total Born-Oppenheimer mean-field free energy is G_can(delta,T)=-T*log(Z4)+6*delta^2. Minimize it over the entire CLOSED delta domain, retaining both physically symmetry-equivalent signs where appropriate.

temperature_studies.requirements: At each listed temperature identify ALL stationary points and both domain endpoints, their local character, every global minimizer, its G_can, the square-geometry curvature G_can_dd(0,T), curvature at a global minimum, and the barrier G_can(0,T)-min_delta G_can. Provide a complete derivative/root-count or equivalent continuum certificate. A dense mesh, one local optimizer or a single stable branch is insufficient. The report arrays use the given temperature order. Negative and positive distortions are distinct source-coordinate minima even though a molecular symmetry exchanges them.

local_bifurcation: Locate every T in[0.3,0.6] at which G_can_dd(0,T)=0. At the identified temperature give the coefficient of delta^4 in the expansion of G_can(delta,T)-G_can(0,T), including its sign; do not report the fourth derivative without dividing by4!. Classify the LOCAL symmetry-breaking bifurcation of the minimized classical distortion model. At the marginal point, a zero quadratic curvature alone is neither strict quadratic stability nor proof of an unstable local maximum. Do not assert a thermodynamic phase transition of a finite molecular quantum partition function: for every fixed delta its finite-state canonical partition is analytic forT>0.
matched_mean_ensemble_audit: Compare with the grand-canonical replacement at chemical potential mu=0: Omega=-2*T*sum_j log(1+exp(-epsilon_j/T)), G_grand=Omega+mu*4+6*delta^2. At delta=0,T=0.4 report its mean pi-electron number and particle-number variance, its total delta curvature, and ALL global minimizing distortions atT=0.4. Also give every root in[0.3,0.6] of its square-geometry curvature. The bipartite spectrum can make the grand mean exactly4; that does not impose fixed particle number in each state. Compare the distortion conclusions atT=0.4 without treating the ensembles as equivalent.
zero_temperature_audit: Compute the exact zero-temperature electronic ground energy as a function of signed delta by filling the four lowest spin orbitals. Give all minimizers of ground_energy+6*delta^2 over[-0.5,0.5], its minimum total energy, and the electronic ground-state Slater-determinant degeneracy atdelta=0. State whether the zero-temperature electronic energy is differentiable atdelta=0. Do not smooth a level-crossing cusp or confuse a spatial-orbital degeneracy with the number of many-electron states.

interpretation_proposals.A: A fixed-electron-number ensemble needs the complete Pauli-allowed many-body occupation law and correct spin multiplicities.
interpretation_proposals.B: A grand ensemble with mean electron number4 has exactly the same structural response as the canonical4electron molecule.
interpretation_proposals.C: A signed bond-alternation coordinate requires retaining both symmetry-related global minima.
interpretation_proposals.D: The number of Kekule double-bond tokens directly determines occupied Hückel orbitals and their unique spin state.
interpretation_proposals.E: Zero quadratic curvature requires higher-order analysis before deciding the local character of the marginal geometry.
interpretation_proposals.F: A bifurcation after classical minimization proves a true finite-temperature singularity of the fixed-geometry finite-molecule partition.
interpretation_proposals.G: The zero-temperature limit can have a level-crossing cusp even though the positive-temperature finite-state free energy is smooth.
interpretation_proposals.H: This controlled noninteracting model establishes the real experimental cyclobutadiene distortion and transition temperature.

reporting: molecular_formula; heavy_atom_count; graph_cycle_rank; spatial_orbital_count; pi_electron_count; canonical_spin_state_count; grouped_spatial_occupation_count; temperatures; all_canonical_minimizing_distortions (one sorted array per temperature); canonical_minimum_free_energies; canonical_barriers_from_square; square_geometry_curvatures; canonical_minimum_curvatures; canonical_local_bifurcation_temperatures; canonical_quartic_coefficient_at_bifurcation; local_bifurcation_type string; grand_mean_electron_number_at_T04; grand_particle_number_variance_at_T04; grand_square_curvature_at_T04; all_grand_minimizing_distortions_at_T04; grand_local_bifurcation_temperatures; all_zero_temperature_minimizing_distortions; zero_temperature_minimum_total_energy; square_zero_temperature_manybody_degeneracy; zero_temperature_electronic_energy_differentiable_at_square boolean; valid_interpretation_proposal_ids. Use local_bifurcation_type=supercritical_pitchfork, subcritical_pitchfork, other orunresolved according to the local derivative evidence. Counts, formula, booleans and IDs exact; numeric absolute tolerance1e-7. Retain actual graph reports, typed spectra, complete state/partition law, derivatives, continuum certificates, marginal higher-order audit and ensemble comparison in the trajectory.

methodological_source.title: Stability of polyatomic molecules in degenerate electronic states. I. Orbital degeneracy
methodological_source.role: Historical primary context for electronic degeneracy and structural stability. The fixed-N finite-temperature model, elastic penalty and all numerical cases are own constructions, not measurements, data extraction or a quantitative assertion from that paper.
